workflows.name: Worker Onboarding Flow
workflows.description: Process for onboarding new workers into the system

steps.name: Registration
steps.description: Worker registers in the system with basic information

steps.name: Profile Creation
steps.description: Worker completes their profile with personal and professional details

steps.name: Document Upload
steps.description: Worker uploads required identification and qualification documents

steps.name: Profile Verification
steps.description: Employee verifies worker profile and documents

steps.name: Onboarding Complete
steps.description: Worker is fully onboarded and can browse and apply for vacancies

workflows.name: Application Processing Flow
workflows.description: Process for handling job applications from submission to completion

steps.name: Application Submission
steps.description: Worker submits application for a specific vacancy

steps.name: Initial Review
steps.description: Employee reviews application and changes status to 'processing' if complete

steps.name: Document Verification
steps.description: Employee verifies all required documents for the application

steps.name: Final Decision
steps.description: Employee makes final decision on application (approved/rejected)

steps.name: Completion
steps.description: For approved applications, employee marks as 'completed' when all processes are finished

workflows.name: Document Management Flow
workflows.description: Process for handling document uploads, verification, and management

steps.name: Document Upload
steps.description: Worker uploads required documents for their application

steps.name: Document Review
steps.description: Employee reviews uploaded documents for completeness and clarity

steps.name: Document Verification
steps.description: Employee verifies the authenticity of documents

steps.name: Additional Documents Request
steps.description: If needed, employee requests additional documents from worker

steps.name: Document Approval
steps.description: Employee approves all documents as verified and complete

workflows.name: Job Application Flow
workflows.description: Process for workers to find and apply for job vacancies

steps.name: Browse Vacancies
steps.description: Worker browses available job vacancies

steps.name: View Vacancy Details
steps.description: Worker views detailed information about a specific vacancy

steps.name: Submit Application
steps.description: Worker submits application for the selected vacancy

steps.name: Upload Supporting Documents
steps.description: Worker uploads required documents for the application

steps.name: Track Application Status
steps.description: Worker tracks the status of their submitted application

workflows.name: Employee Management Flow
workflows.description: Process for managing employees and their permissions

steps.name: Employee Registration
steps.description: Admin registers new employee in the system

steps.name: Assign Permissions
steps.description: Admin assigns specific permissions to the employee

steps.name: Employee Training
steps.description: Employee completes required training modules

steps.name: Performance Monitoring
steps.description: Admin monitors employee performance and application processing metrics

steps.name: Permission Updates
steps.description: Admin updates employee permissions as needed
